# upgrade all packages to latest possible versions
flutter pub upgrade --major-versions --unlock-transitive --tighten

# run all code generation (including localization)
dart run build_runner build\

# clean all generated files
dart run build_runner clean

# run all tests
flutter test --test-randomize-ordering-seed=random

# detect unused and missing translations
dart run slang analyze

# sort translations according to base locale
dart run slang normalize

# automatically update CFBundleLocalizations
dart run slang configure
